newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Retail unit files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Retail unit files for Chapter 11.

text.p: WESTPORT, Conn., Jan 31 - Specialty Retail Group Inc said on Friday its Building Blocks Inc subsidiary filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
Specialty also said it sold its Building Blocks Franchise Corp toy store franchising subsidiary, for an undisclosed amount to an unidentified buyer.

Specialty said it continues to seek a business combination partner. The company said its obligations are "substantially in excess of its very limited cash resources," and it has been receiving cash advances from a stockholder to meet its operating expenses.
